question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT co.order_id, co.pizza_id, co.exclusions, co.extras
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
    WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL OR ro.cancellation = ''
),
pizza_toppings_detail AS (
    SELECT 
        d.order_id,
        d.pizza_id,
        d.exclusions,
        d.extras,
        p.toppings
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN pizza_recipes p ON d.pizza_id = p.pizza_id
),
recipe_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        TRIM(unnest(string_split(toppings, ','))) AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_toppings_detail
),
excluded_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        TRIM(unnest(string_split(exclusions, ','))) AS excluded_topping_id
    FROM pizza_toppings_detail
    WHERE exclusions IS NOT NULL AND exclusions != ''
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        TRIM(unnest(string_split(extras, ','))) AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_toppings_detail
    WHERE extras IS NOT NULL AND extras != ''
),
base_toppings AS (
    SELECT rt.order_id, rt.topping_id
    FROM recipe_toppings rt
    LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings et ON rt.order_id = et.order_id AND rt.topping_id = et.excluded_topping_id
    WHERE et.excluded_topping_id IS NULL
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT order_id, topping_id FROM base_toppings
    UNION ALL
    SELECT order_id, topping_id FROM extra_toppings
)
SELECT pt.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS quantity
FROM all_toppings x
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON x.topping_id = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY pt.topping_name;
